natural_body: Deep discounts spike signups +31% but risk renewal. Use tactically with guardrails.

first.rationale: Activation is down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion down 4% QoQ. Memory_91 shows activation_messaging inside the product improved week-one engagement and drove accounts to their first meaningful action. Memory_86 confirms that shortening onboarding improved completion and time-to-value. Memory_31 demonstrates that signup simplification lifted first-week activation durably. Rather than deploying promotional_pricing (which memory_73 flags as carrying renewal risk and would be reactive to competitor pricing), activation_messaging addresses the core metric decline directly. It targets existing users in the product where we have control and engagement leverage. This avoids the renewal risk of deep discounts and preserves focus on qualified revenue over volume. Verifying memory_31 and memory_91 to confirm effect sizes and guardrails before deploying. A standard_experiment scope allows measured risk while preserving the option to scale if successful.
